name: dynamical
description: A programmable interface for agents to build virtual laboratories, run adaptive experiments, and make evidence-grounded scientific decisions.

interface.shortDescription: Build virtual labs for evidence-grounded scientific research
interface.longDescription: Use Dynamical when a scientific question needs evidence from models, simulators, datasets, or instruments. It lets an agent compose available capabilities into a virtual laboratory, run and adapt experiments, and preserve validated campaign records for scientific decisions. Facilities retain control of physical execution.
defaultPrompt: Use Dynamical to build and run a virtual lab for this scientific question, then recommend the most useful next experiment.
